newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 30.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 30.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Weak cold front along the Baja California coast, with possible rains later in the day. Winds from the north at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.

Skies clear to partly cloudy with possible light rains later in day along Veracruz coast. Predominant winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high. -- Caribbean:
Hot and clear to partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
